CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.attach_transactions_to_settlement(p_settlement_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  target_space_id uuid;
  target_from_user uuid;
  target_to_user uuid;
  target_created_at timestamptz;
begin

  select
    s.space_id,
    s.from_user,
    s.to_user,
    s.created_at
  into
    target_space_id,
    target_from_user,
    target_to_user,
    target_created_at
  from public.settlements s
  where s.id = p_settlement_id;


  if target_space_id is null then
    raise exception
      'Settlement not found.';
  end if;


  insert into public.settlement_transactions (
    settlement_id,
    transaction_id
  )
  select distinct
    p_settlement_id,
    t.id
  from public.transactions t

  join public.transaction_splits ts
    on ts.transaction_id = t.id

  where
    t.space_id = target_space_id

    and t.created_at <= target_created_at

    and t.type = 'expense'

    and coalesce(
      t.split_type,
      'none'
    ) <> 'none'

    and ts.amount > 0

    and (
      (
        t.paid_by = target_to_user
        and ts.user_id = target_from_user
      )

      or

      (
        t.paid_by = target_from_user
        and ts.user_id = target_to_user
      )
    )

  on conflict (
    settlement_id,
    transaction_id
  )
  do nothing;

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_manage_transaction(target_transaction_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.transactions t
    where t.id = target_transaction_id
      and (
        t.created_by = auth.uid()
        or public.is_space_owner(t.space_id)
      )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_member_space_balance(target_space_id uuid, target_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  transaction_balance numeric := 0;
  settlement_balance numeric := 0;
begin

  -- -------------------------------------------------------
  -- 1. Must be signed in
  -- -------------------------------------------------------

  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'You must be signed in.';
  end if;


  -- -------------------------------------------------------
  -- 2. Space must exist and must be shared
  -- -------------------------------------------------------

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.spaces
    where id = target_space_id
      and type = 'shared'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Shared space not found.';
  end if;


  -- -------------------------------------------------------
  -- 3. Only the active owner can inspect another member
  -- -------------------------------------------------------

  if not public.is_space_owner(
    target_space_id
  ) then
    raise exception
      'Only the space owner can check another member balance.';
  end if;


  -- -------------------------------------------------------
  -- 4. Target user must have a membership record
  --
  -- We intentionally do not require status = active here.
  -- Historical/inactive members can still have financial
  -- history that needs to remain understandable.
  -- -------------------------------------------------------

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.space_members
    where space_id = target_space_id
      and user_id = target_user_id
  ) then
    raise exception
      'This user does not belong to this shared space.';
  end if;


  -- -------------------------------------------------------
  -- 5. Calculate transaction balance
  --
  -- Positive:
  --   target member is owed money
  --
  -- Negative:
  --   target member owes money
  -- -------------------------------------------------------

  select
    coalesce(
      sum(
        case

          when
            t.type = 'expense'
            and t.paid_by = target_user_id
            and ts.user_id <> target_user_id
          then ts.amount

          when
            t.type = 'expense'
            and t.paid_by <> target_user_id
            and ts.user_id = target_user_id
          then -ts.amount

          else 0

        end
      ),
      0
    )
  into transaction_balance
  from public.transactions t
  join public.transaction_splits ts
    on ts.transaction_id = t.id
  where t.space_id = target_space_id;


  -- -------------------------------------------------------
  -- 6. Apply settlements
  --
  -- If target member received money:
  --   amount owed to them decreases.
  --
  -- If target member paid money:
  --   amount they owe decreases.
  -- -------------------------------------------------------

  select
    coalesce(
      sum(
        case

          when s.to_user = target_user_id
          then -s.amount

          when s.from_user = target_user_id
          then s.amount

          else 0

        end
      ),
      0
    )
  into settlement_balance
  from public.settlements s
  where s.space_id = target_space_id;


  return round(
    transaction_balance +
    settlement_balance,
    2
  );

end;
$function$

functions.name: get_my_space_balance
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_space_balance(target_space_id uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  current_user_id uuid;
  transaction_balance numeric := 0;
  settlement_balance numeric := 0;
begin

  current_user_id := auth.uid();

  if current_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'You must be signed in.';
  end if;


  -- The user may be an active member now.
  -- This function is primarily used immediately
  -- before leaving the shared space.
  if not public.is_space_member(
    target_space_id
  ) then
    raise exception
      'You are not an active member of this space.';
  end if;


  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.spaces
    where id = target_space_id
      and type = 'shared'
  ) then
    raise exception
      'This is not a shared space.';
  end if;


  -- =====================================================
  -- TRANSACTIONS
  --
  -- For every split expense:
  --
  -- If I paid:
  --   other people's shares increase what I am owed.
  --
  -- If someone else paid:
  --   my share increases what I owe.
  --
  -- My own share of something I paid does not create debt.
  -- =====================================================

  select
    coalesce(
      sum(
        case

          when
            t.type = 'expense'
            and t.paid_by = current_user_id
            and ts.user_id <> current_user_id
          then ts.amount

          when
            t.type = 'expense'
            and t.paid_by <> current_user_id
            and ts.user_id = current_user_id
          then -ts.amount

          else 0

        end
      ),
      0
    )
  into transaction_balance
  from public.transactions t
  join public.transaction_splits ts
    on ts.transaction_id = t.id
  where t.space_id = target_space_id;


  -- =====================================================
  -- SETTLEMENTS
  --
  -- from_user paid to_user.
  --
  -- If I received money:
  --   the amount owed to me decreases.
  --
  -- If I paid money:
  --   the amount I owe decreases.
  -- =====================================================

  select
    coalesce(
      sum(
        case

          when s.to_user = current_user_id
          then -s.amount

          when s.from_user = current_user_id
          then s.amount

          else 0

        end
      ),
      0
    )
  into settlement_balance
  from public.settlements s
  where s.space_id = target_space_id;


  return round(
    transaction_balance +
    settlement_balance,
    2
  );

end;
$function$

functions.name: handle_new_user
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  new_space_id uuid;
  user_name text;
begin

  user_name :=
    coalesce(
      new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'display_name',
      new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name',
      split_part(new.email, '@', 1),
      'User'
    );

  insert into public.profiles (
    id,
    display_name
  )
  values (
    new.id,
    user_name
  );

  insert into public.spaces (
    name,
    type,
    currency,
    created_by
  )
  values (
    'My Money',
    'personal',
    'USD',
    new.id
  )
  returning id into new_space_id;

  insert into public.space_members (
    space_id,
    user_id,
    role
  )
  values (
    new_space_id,
    new.id,
    'owner'
  );

  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: leave_shared_space
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.leave_shared_space(target_space_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  current_role text;
  current_status text;
begin

  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception
      'You must be signed in.';
  end if;


  -- Make sure the destination exists
  -- and is a shared space.
  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.spaces
    where id = target_space_id
      and type = 'shared'
  ) then
    raise exception
      'This shared space does not exist.';
  end if;


  -- Load the current user's membership.
  select
    role,
    status
  into
    current_role,
    current_status
  from public.space_members
  where space_id = target_space_id
    and user_id = auth.uid()
  limit 1;


  if current_role is null then
    raise exception
      'You are not a member of this shared space.';
  end if;


  -- The owner cannot simply leave.
  --
  -- Ownership transfer / space deletion will
  -- be handled separately.
  if current_role = 'owner' then
    raise exception
      'The space owner cannot leave the shared space.';
  end if;


  if current_status <> 'active' then
    raise exception
      'You are not an active member of this shared space.';
  end if;


  -- Preserve the membership record and history.
  -- Do not DELETE the row.
  update public.space_members
  set
    status = 'left',
    left_at = now()
  where space_id = target_space_id
    and user_id = auth.uid();


  return target_space_id;

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_shared_transaction_payer()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.spaces
    where id = new.space_id
      and type = 'shared'
  ) and not exists (
    select 1
    from public.space_members
    where space_id = new.space_id
      and user_id = new.paid_by
      and status = 'active'
  ) then
    raise exception 'The payer must be an active member of this shared space.';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$
